sources.title: MobileNet | tensorflow/tfjs-models | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: MobileNet is a pre-trained image classification model in TensorFlow.js that provides efficient classification capabilities with low latency and size. This document covers the implementation, architecture, and usage of the MobileNet model in the TensorFlow.js models repository.
